## Purpose

Renders "My Workflows" â€” the user's saved custom-agent-selection workflows, as a searchable card grid
with rename/duplicate/delete actions and a run button. Mounted by `DashboardLayout` for
`mainView === "saved-workflows"`.

## Shape

- [SavedWorkflowsPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/savedworkflows/SavedWorkflowsPage.tsx) â€” fetches `getUserWorkflows` on mount, filters client-side by
  name/description/pipeline-type search, and renders one card per workflow. A module-level
  `KebabMenu` component (kept outside the page so the parent's state changes never remount the trigger
  button, preserving its `aria-expanded`/focus state) drives:
  - rename (via `renameUserWorkflow`, using catalog's `NameWorkflowModal`)
  - duplicate (`createUserWorkflow`)
  - delete (`deleteUserWorkflow` behind an inline confirm dialog)

## Why this shape

**The kebab menu is deliberately module-level rather than a JSX-inline closure so its DOM identity
survives re-renders** â€” a design decision called out directly in the code, not incidental. Renaming
reuses `catalog/NameWorkflowModal` rather than a local copy, since the two features share the exact
same name+description form.
